messages:
Samira G.: Quick sync: webinar launch on June 10. We need a compact SEO + redirect playbook that preserves attribution, avoids duplicate indexation from tracking params, and surfaces event rich results. Can we draft a 1-page checklist and owners?

Theo R.: I'll summarize rules:
- Use canonical on all parameterized URLs -> point to canonical without UTMs
- Implement 301 redirects for deprecated vanity URLs to canonical (preserve querystring so UTM stays)
- Only list canonical pages in sitemap.xml; temporarily bump <priority> for launch week
- Submit sitemap & request reindex in Search Console after deploy

Priya (Demand Gen): Critical: analytics and SFDC need UTM + webinar_id. Plan: set a first-touch cookie with utm_* + webinar_id and also ensure redirect preserves querystrings for immediate hits. Sales wants query params on the form-submit endpoint.

Theo R.: Technical notes: app-level redirect should do 301 and keep the querystring. Example (express):
```
// preserve querystring
res.redirect(301, '/webinar/clean-url' + req.url.substring(req.path.length));
```
For CDN rewrites check that edge strips nothing.

Jonas P.: Content tasks: merge near-duplicate landing drafts into a single canonical page. Add JSON-LD Event schema with speaker and startDate in ISO8601. Also add Open Graph tags for social. Avoid creating localized hreflang entries unless localized pages exist.

seo-bot: scan: detected missing performer.name and organizer.name in Event schema; startDate must be full ISO string. Risk: rich result eligibility reduced.

Theo R.: JSON-LD example for content team to paste: 
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2024-06-10T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Sasha R."}],"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","url":"https://redwood.example.com"}}
```
Also add same metadata to OG tags: og:title, og:description, og:type=event.

Priya (Demand Gen): For inbound routing: proposed implementation 
- set cookie on first click: cookie_webinar_attrs = JSON string (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id) max-age 30d
- include hidden inputs on the registration form that read from the cookie server-side and POST to SFDC
- track fallback: if cookie absent, fall back to referrer + UTM in URL

Samira G.: Owners/time: 
- Theo: write canonical + redirect enforcement doc with sample nginx + app rules, include check for querystring preservation (owner: Theo)  due: tomorrow EOD
- Jonas: consolidate landing content, add JSON-LD snippet into template, update internal links from blog & docs to canonical (owner: Jonas)  due: in 48 hours
- Priya: spec cookie + SFDC hidden fields, confirm field names with Sales Ops (owner: Priya)  due: tomorrow morning
- Infra: after PR merge, Ops to submit sitemap update and request indexing (owner: Infra)  due: on deploy

Jonas P.: Extra SEO nit: add rel=canonical tag in HEAD pointing to canonical URL without params; add link rel="alternate" hreflang only if we actually have translations. Also avoid indexing of staging domains via robots.

seo-bot: scheduled re-scan 10h after PR merge. Will flag any remaining schema or canonical inconsistencies.

Theo R.: I'll include a short checklist in the shared Launch Tracking sheet:
- canonical set
- redirect rules in place (nginx & app examples)
- 301 preserves querystring
- sitemap updated (canonicals only)
- JSON-LD + OG present
- cookie & hidden fields wired to SFDC
- Search Console reindex requested

Priya (Demand Gen): Also want to run an experiment: keep UTMs in visible URL vs cookie-only for social shares. We'll monitor conversion and attribution completeness.

Samira G.: Flag blockers here if CDN or CSP prevents client-side cookie read, or if Sales Ops needs different field names. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

(reacts: :rocket: :white_check_mark: )
